enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Apply a theme automatically when the wallpaper changes

wallpaper_root.label: Wallpaper Root
wallpaper_root.description: Paths are mapped relative to this folder. Wallpapers outside it are ignored.

dark_dir_names.label: Dark Folder Names
dark_dir_names.description: Comma-separated folder names that mean dark mode

light_dir_names.label: Light Folder Names
light_dir_names.description: Comma-separated folder names that mean light mode

dynamic_dir_names.label: Dynamic Folder Names
dynamic_dir_names.description: Comma-separated folder names whose wallpapers generate their palette from the image instead of using a named scheme

default_dynamic_scheme.label: Default Dynamic Scheme
default_dynamic_scheme.description: Generator used for a dynamic wallpaper that has no remembered scheme

remember_dynamic_scheme.label: Remember Scheme Per Wallpaper
remember_dynamic_scheme.description: When you change the generator while a dynamic wallpaper is active, remember it for that wallpaper and restore it next time

luma_threshold.label: Luma Threshold
luma_threshold.description: Perceptual lightness (CIELAB L*, 0-100) above which a dynamic wallpaper with no Light/Dark parent folder is treated as light. Requires ImageMagick or ffmpeg.

aliases.label: Folder Aliases
aliases.description: Override how a folder name resolves, e.g. Rose-Pine-Moon = community:Rosé Pine Moon. Prefix with builtin:, community:, custom:, wallpaper: or skip:

notify_on_apply.label: Notify On Apply
notify_on_apply.description: Show a notification each time a theme is applied

notify.unresolved-body: No builtin, community or custom palette matches the folder "{name}". The color scheme was left unchanged.
notify.no-luma-body: This dynamic wallpaper has no Light/Dark parent folder, so the mode has to be read from the image. Install ImageMagick or ffmpeg to enable that. The theme mode was left unchanged.
